title: SEC Climate Disclosure Rule: Paused but Reporting Requirements Remain
content: The Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) rule “Enhancement and Standardization of Climate-Related Disclosures for Investors”1 (climate rule) was adopted in March 2024 to standardize climate risk disclosures by public companies and public offerings for investors.
author: David W. South
